# code-graph fixture

A small repo for the before / after views (design pages 11 and 12, D43): `docs/system/` is
rehearse v1 as built, cut down to the parts page 11 draws, and
`docs/epics/2026-11-05-code-graph/` is a draft of the code-graph EPIC with its
`architecture.yaml` change. It is a test copy, not the real code-graph folder.
`docs/epics/2026-11-05-rehearse/brainstorm.md` only lists the decisions the change cites (D4, D19).
